sections.heading: 1. Seated pelvic tilts
lines: ① Tuck a rolled jumper behind your lower back.
② Tilt your pelvis forward and back, slowly × 10.
③ Knee lifts and ankle circles, 10 each.
④ After landing: a 10–20 min walk first.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: No easing after a few days

caption:
Fourteen hours in seat 42C, and Mr Turtle's lower back feels welded shut.

Hours in a cramped seat with little room to shift usually means stiffness, not damage, and it often eases within a day or two.

In the air: pelvic tilts with a rolled jumper behind you, knee lifts, ankle circles and a short aisle walk when it's safe. Lift cabin bags close to your body in two steps. After landing, walk for 10–20 minutes before you rest.

Leg weakness, groin numbness or bladder changes need prompt care, and calf pain with swelling or sudden breathlessness needs urgent help. Still stiff days later? Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can assess it. Book online via the link in bio ✈️
